title: Garb brings alms
literal_meaning: With the garb, one receives alms.
meaning_odia: ଭେକ ବା ବେଶ ଥିଲେ ଭିକ ମିଳେ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ବାହ୍ୟ ପରିଚ୍ଛଦ ଦେଖି ଲୋକେ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଭୂମିକା ଚିହ୍ନନ୍ତି ଓ ସେହି ଅନୁସାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ବା ସମ୍ମାନ ଦେଇପାରନ୍ତି। ସେହି ବେଶ ମିଛ ବା ଭିକ ମାଗୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ଠକ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିରୁ ଧରାଯାଉନାହିଁ।
explanation: A visible sign of a role is linked to the response it brings. Read editorially, the rhyme notices how appearance can influence recognition and material help. It leaves open whether the garb is sincere or assumed, and does not make alms a guaranteed reward for dressing a certain way.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A group notices that people respond more readily when a visitor’s role is clear from their dress. Someone recalls this saying about garb and alms.
cultural_context: ଭେକ and ଭିକ differ by a vowel, turning dress and alms into a compact pair. The saying focuses on what presentation elicits from others, rather than describing a particular garment or proving the wearer’s character.

witnesses.locator: Page32, third item beginning ଭେକ ଥିଲେ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact wording retained. ଭେକ rendered garb, without assuming disguise or deception. Wider recognition/response reading editorial.
